sections.eyebrow: The new taste of The Feed Sack
sections.title: Made with care, *from appetizers to desserts*
body: Our menu is carefully crafted to showcase the freshest ingredients and bold flavors. From appetizers to desserts, every dish is made with care and attention to detail.
The Feed Sack has two full bars and a retail wine selection, with an exclusive wine and cocktail menu. Everything is also available for pickup, or for delivery on DoorDash and Uber Eats.

sections.title: Come experience it.
sections.text: Call for a table, or order pickup.

before: The site's security certificate has expired, so browsers stop visitors with a full-page warning before they see the menu
A second check of the site returned a "service unavailable" error
The words on this concept come from the restaurant's public Visit Aiken listing; the menu itself would come from the owner
after: No certificate to renew: HTTPS is automatic and stays current
A working page, today: phone, address, map and what's on this week
One-tap call and directions on a phone
Ready for a real, readable menu as soon as the restaurant supplies it
